title: 第1章 没白来
slug: 道君全本免费-道君最新章节列表
content_zh:
强光近距离照射石壁时，黑暗中辉映出了男子的模样。
中年男子，清瘦，背头发丝不乱，面容白净，精气神十足，两眼十分有神，神态淡定从容。
整个人打理的干干净净，穿戴也很整齐，一身黑色唐装，手持一根笔挺的手杖。
如此整洁妆容出现在这种墓穴环境下，不认识的觉得少见，认识的则会觉得很正常。这是位‘地下考古工作者’，早年江湖上人称盗爷，后来随着江湖资历以及地位的增长，被人尊称为道爷。
如今一般情况下，道爷都在闭关清修，真如道士一般，很少亲自出马，只有遇上比较有趣的地方才会亲自走一走，譬如眼前的墓穴形制就很罕见。
手杖随着步伐咚咚点击着地面，待到地面发出“当”一声金属撞击声，道爷停步，并没有急着看地下，而是目光随着手电光柱扫视前方四周，眼前出现了一个漆黑的巨大地下空间，光柱照射下能大概分辨出到了墓穴的地宫，如此巨大的地宫极为罕见。
大致观察了一下四周，手电光柱才照到了脚下，手杖在地面再次“当当”敲击了几声，又用脚尖在地面蹭了两下，刮去一片积尘，露出了略带古铜色光泽的金属地面。
手杖一提，夹在了拿手电的胳膊下，空出一手自然垂放，又缓缓虚提手掌，地下积尘微微出现气旋，突然翻掌朝前一推，内力喷薄，掌风呼一声吹了出去，一路荡开前方地面的积尘，连拍几掌，尘土飞扬。
手抓了手杖又杵在身边静候，翻涌的灰尘难近其身，强光手电朝着掌风刮开积尘的地面看去，可以判断出，前方十几米的半径内的地面都是金属铺就的，并非只是脚下一小块地方，金属地面上似乎有雕刻的纹路，不把积尘全部清除的话，难见完整真容。
待到尘埃落定，道爷继续拄着手杖前行，手电不时照看上方的穹顶，这地宫四周，还有数个黑黝黝入口，如同他走进来的甬道一般，只是不知通往何处，尽头又藏着什么秘密。
“这种形制还真是没见过，有意思…”道爷微笑嘀咕，脚下却发出咔嚓一声，似乎把地面给踩陷了一块，紧接着地下似乎传来嗡嗡声，有机簧的动静在响。
轰！进来的甬道方向传来重物落地的震撼声。
道爷脸色微变，凭他的经验一听便知是进来的通道被落下的什么东西给阻断了。
紧接着其他几处黑黝黝的洞口又传来沉闷的嘎吱声，似乎是有什么重门道爷脚下松开，退了几步，手电快速环照四周，心知是踩中了机关，不知道触发了墓室的什么机关布置，能断进出通道，就说明这机关来者不善。
他高度警惕四周，然而静候了一会儿，四周静悄悄一片，听不到任何动静。
反倒是进来的入口方向传来“咣”一声爆炸的震响，震的这里地面都颤动，嗡嗡声回荡在地宫内。
很快，他察觉到了嗡嗡回荡声中传来了不一样的动静，手电光迅速照向了一个黑黝黝洞口，似乎是有什么东西在奔跑的动静，光照下一双绿油油的眼睛从那洞口深处出现，紧接着轮廓完整呈现，一个衣衫褴褛的人出现了。
也不像人，干尸般，浑身长着白毛，尖牙利齿，手电下眼冒绿光，十指尖爪青黑锋利，狂冲出洞口，发出咆哮声朝他直扑了过来，四周洞口皆有出现。
僵尸！道爷脑中闪过一个念头，手上没停，手杖把手一拧，顺势一道寒光从杖内出鞘，身体轻闪快退一步，侧身避开僵尸凌厉一扑，手起一道剑光，刹那从僵尸颈部带出一蓬绿血。
僵尸头颅飞了出去，与身子分了家，身躯咣的砸在了地面，在地面抽搐着，爬了几次爬不起来。

道爷动静却未停，手中剑光连闪，一道道扑来的人影被他斩落在地，只见手电光在他身前乱晃。
不止一只僵尸，四周洞口内不断有僵尸朝他咆哮着狂冲而来，越来越多。
围攻之下，措手不及，仅凭手中剑已来不及御敌，手脚并用，仓促之下一剑刺穿一只僵尸的心脏，却发现刺穿心脏部位没用，那僵尸仍然一爪拍来。道爷身下一脚飙出，力道雄浑，把那僵尸踹的倒飞了出去撞翻了后面几只，不待脚落，身体腾空旋身一记后踹，又踹飞一只，再次凌空扭腰翻腿连踢，快速踢飞了几只，手中寒光又斩下了几颗脑袋。

content_en:
When the strong light shone on the stone wall at close range, the man's appearance was reflected in the darkness.
A middle-aged man, thin, with unkempt hair on his back, fair face, full of energy, very bright eyes, and a calm and calm demeanor.
He was neatly groomed and neatly dressed, wearing a black Tang suit and holding a straight cane.
Such neat makeup appears in this tomb environment. Those who don't know it will think it is rare, while those who know it will think it is normal. This is an 'underground archaeologist'. In his early years, people in the world were called Master Pirates. Later, as his seniority and status in the world increased, he was respected as Master Dao.
Nowadays, under normal circumstances, Taoist masters are in retreat. Just like Taoist priests, they rarely go out in person. They only visit interesting places in person. For example, the shape of the tomb in front of you is very rare.
The cane clicked on the ground with the steps, and when the ground made a metallic clang sound, Master Dao stopped. He did not look at the ground in a hurry, but scanned the surroundings in front of him along with the flashlight beam. A huge dark underground space appeared in front of him. Under the light beam, he could roughly distinguish the underground palace of the tomb. Such a huge underground palace is extremely rare.
After roughly observing the surroundings, the flashlight beam shone at the feet. The cane hit the ground a few more times, and then rubbed the ground twice with the tip of the toe, scraping away a piece of dust, revealing a metal floor with a slight bronze luster.
He lifted the cane and put it under the arm holding the flashlight. He let his free hand hang down naturally, and then slowly raised his palm. A slight vortex appeared in the dust on the ground. Suddenly he turned his palm and pushed it forward. The internal force erupted, and the palm blew out with a roar, sweeping away the dust on the ground in front of him. He slapped several palms and the dust flew up.
He grabbed his cane and waited beside him. The surging dust made it difficult to get close to him. He looked at the ground where the dust had been blown away by the wind of his hand with a strong flashlight. It could be judged that the ground within a radius of more than ten meters in front was paved with metal. It was not just a small area under his feet. There seemed to be carved patterns on the metal ground. If all the dust was not removed, it would be difficult to see the complete appearance.
When the dust settled, Master Tao continued to move forward with his cane, looking at the dome above with his flashlight from time to time. There were several dark entrances around the underground palace, just like the corridor he walked in, but he didn't know where it led and what secrets were hidden at the end.
"I've never seen this kind of shape before, it's interesting..." Dao Master smiled and murmured, but there was a click under his feet, which seemed to have sunk a piece of the ground, and then there seemed to be a buzzing sound coming from the ground, and the sound of organic springs.
boom! There was a shocking sound of heavy objects falling to the ground from the direction of the corridor.
Master Dao's expression changed slightly. Based on his experience, he knew at a glance that the incoming passage was blocked by something falling.
Immediately afterwards, there were dull creaking sounds from several other dark cave entrances. It seemed that some important Taoist priest had loosened his footing and took a few steps back. He quickly looked around with his flashlight, knowing that he had stepped on a trap. He didn't know what mechanism had been triggered in the tomb. If it could cut off the entrance and exit, it meant that the trap was not malicious.
He was highly alert to his surroundings, but after waiting for a while, the surroundings were quiet and no movement could be heard.
On the contrary, there was a "bang" sound from the direction of the entrance, which shook the ground here, and the buzzing sound echoed in the underground palace.
Soon, he noticed a different movement coming from the reverberating sound. The flashlight quickly shone at the entrance of a dark hole, as if there was the movement of something running. Under the light, a pair of green eyes appeared from the depths of the hole, and then the outline appeared completely, and a man in ragged clothes appeared.
It didn't look like a human being either. It was like a mummy, with white hair all over its body, sharp fangs, green eyes glowing under the flashlight, and black and sharp fingertips. It rushed out of the cave entrance, roared and rushed towards him, appearing at the cave entrances all around.
Zombies! An idea flashed through Master Dao's mind. He didn't have anyStop, twist the handle of the cane, and a cold light emerges from the sheath of the cane. He takes a quick step back, sideways to avoid the zombie and pounces sharply. He raises a sword light, and instantly brings out a puff of green blood from the zombie's neck.
The zombie's head flew out and separated from its body. The body hit the ground and twitched on the ground. After crawling several times, it couldn't get up.
The movement of Master Dao did not stop, the sword in his hand flashed, and the figures that rushed towards him were cut to the ground by him, and the flashlight light was seen swaying in front of him.
There was more than one zombie, and there were more and more zombies roaring and rushing toward him in the surrounding caves.
Under siege, he was caught off guard. It was too late to fend off the enemy with his sword. He used his hands and feet in a hurry. He pierced the heart of a zombie with his sword, but found that piercing the heart was useless. The zombie still slapped him with a claw. Daoye kicked out a kick with great force, knocking the zombies backwards and knocking over the ones behind him. Before his feet could land, he spun around in the air and kicked another one away. He twisted his waist and turned his legs again in the air and kicked several zombies away quickly. The cold light in his hand cut off a few more heads.
